label: Dodd-Frank — TILA Authority Transferred to CFPB
source: Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act, Pub. L. 111-203 (July 21, 2010)
key_changes: TILA rulemaking and enforcement authority transferred from Federal Reserve Board to CFPB
Regulation Z re-adopted by CFPB at 12 C.F.R. Part 1026
CFPB active enforcement of auto lending TILA violations including yo-yo financing
